# Task: an email to a partner or investor

Write an email to [name, role, company] about [subject].

- Why I am writing: [one sentence]
- Context they need: [two or three facts]
- The one thing I want from them: [the ask]
- Signed: [first name]

Shape: the first line says why you are writing. Two or three sentences of context. One clear ask. A first-name sign-off. For an update, follow Matteo's order: (1) what happened, and deal flow; (2) what I am thinking; (3) the idea or next steps; (4) product updates, if any; (5) the ask. No contractions. No "I hope this finds you well", no "just following up", no "reaching out".

Give me the subject line and the email.
